days.title: Riverside Exploration and Wine Tasting
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Kamp
stops.detail: The nature park in the southeastern Waldviertel at the transition to the Weinviertel is characterized by the river landscape along the Kamp (from the Celtic word "kambos" - the "curved one").

stops.name: Fluss-Lehrpfades
stops.detail: Along the River Educational Trail, the breathtaking fauna and flora as well as the great scenic diversity are presented in more detail at various stations.

stops.name: Manhartsberges
stops.detail: Other striking landscape elements are the slopes of the vineyards and the forests of the Manhartsberg, which line the river here.

stops.name: Kamptal
stops.detail: The path leads through the vineyards that characterize the area and offers beautiful views into the Kamp Valley; information boards along the path provide information about viticulture in the Kamp Valley.

stops.name: Kalvarienberg
stops.detail: The circular hiking trail leads over former terraces to the Manhartsberg with a magnificent view and distant view and via the Kalvarienberg back to Schönberg.
